name: Darfellan
sourceDistinctions: Page 37 gives the main playable traits. Page 143 supplies the type and +0 level adjustment and also presents separate Warrior and Barbarian stat blocks.
The sample Warrior prints a secondary bite bonus that differs from the p. 37 formula. These original builds follow the explicit player rule and core secondary damage.
Page 144 supplies the Handle Animal rule for marine mammals in the combat prose, outside both player trait lists.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Stormwrack errata file. The official FAQ has no Darfellan entry.
